interpretations: For each insurance status among sites with conservation records, including a missing status as its own group, count distinct site codes and divide that count by the sum of those status counts without rounding.

For each insurance status present in the sites table, including a missing status as its own group, count distinct site codes with conservation records (zero where none qualify) and divide by the sum of the status counts without rounding.
queries:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.insurstat,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS site_count
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanconservation AS c
    ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.insurstat
)
SELECT insurstat,
       CAST(site_count AS REAL) / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS proportion
FROM status_counts;

WITH status_counts AS (
    SELECT insurstat, COUNT(*) AS status_count
    FROM sites
    GROUP BY insurstat
),
conservation_counts AS (
    SELECT s.insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count
    FROM sites AS s
    LEFT JOIN scanconservation AS c
        ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY s.insurstat
)
SELECT sc.insurstat,
       COALESCE(cc.site_count, 0) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(status_count) FROM status_counts) AS proportion
FROM status_counts AS sc
LEFT JOIN conservation_counts AS cc
    ON cc.insurstat IS sc.insurstat
